info.name:
Gets the anchor rapid and its surrounding rapids within the results slice, in the order
 and filter the results grid renders, so the explorer can step neighbour-to-neighbour.

params.name: rapidId
params.description: The rapid to anchor navigation on.

params.name: correlationId
params.description: The correlation id whose result slice to navigate.

params.name: states
params.description: Optional rapid states to filter by; all states are included when omitted.

params.name: window
params.description: The maximum number of neighbours to return on each side.

params.name: includeNotAccepted
params.description: When true, not-accepted responses count toward the anchor's sample and aggregation.

params.name: includeOverflow
params.description: When true, overflow responses count toward the anchor's sample and aggregation.

items.docs:
Navigation follows the grid's default order (flagged rapids first, then by id) over the
 given correlation slice. Returns 404 when the rapid is not part of the filtered slice.

info.name: Recalculates the compare AB summary counters of a correlation from scratch.

items.docs:
Admin-only verification/repair tool. The counters are normally maintained by rapid
 completion and rejection events; this overwrites them with freshly aggregated values.

info.name: Rejects a completed rapid, marking its results as invalid.

params.name: rapidId
params.description: The identifier of the rapid to reject.

items.docs: The rapid must be in the Done state. Rejection propagates staleness to dependent entities.
